name: synapse
description: Route Synapse tasks and capture authenticated cloud session memory.

interface.shortDescription: Route tasks and preserve durable session memory.
interface.longDescription: Sign in and enable incoming tasks directly in Codex. Synapse keeps one saved local Git receiving project per account on this Mac; any local chat can wake one bounded background delivery. No separate runner or repository checkout is needed. Durable session memory is captured every ten completed turns and after compaction.
